## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the changes proposed in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Verification and Testing

- [ ] `npm test` passes across all workspaces
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project code style and guidelines
